alignment.rit_meaning: Size of the PDF file in kilobytes.
alignment.rationale: Same broad size concept, but the official CIC page does not state its unit and the mirror must not be assumed byte-identical or identically scaled.

alignment.rit_meaning: Size of metadata extracted from the PDF file, in bytes.
alignment.rationale: Both dictionaries describe metadata-section size; compatible numeric quantity, with CIC's observed -1 raw sentinel retained and separately audited.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of pages in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Same page-count concept, but RIT documents corrupted files as pages=0 while CIC has observed -1 values with no verified CIC sentinel semantics.

alignment.rit_meaning: xref length as extracted from the file header.
alignment.rationale: Both dictionaries describe the Xref length/entry quantity; local maxima and numeric representation are compatible evidence, while CIC -1 remains an unverified raw sentinel.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of characters in the file title.
alignment.rationale: Both dictionaries describe the number of title characters; compatible numeric character count, with CIC's raw -1 sentinel retained.

alignment.rit_meaning: 1 if the file is encrypted; 0 otherwise.
alignment.rationale: Related encryption indicator, but CIC observed values extend beyond binary 0/1 and its special-value representation is unverified.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of embedded files inside the PDF, as extracted from the header.
alignment.rationale: Both dictionaries describe a count of embedded files and use a numeric local representation; no unit conversion is required.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of images in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Same image-count concept, but CIC stores category strings and includes malformed lexical values such as 1(1); no coercion is defensible yet.

alignment.rit_meaning: Whether the file contains at least the default threshold of 50 text characters.
alignment.rationale: RIT is a documented >=50-character ternary signal; CIC documents text presence with Yes/No/unclear/-1/0 values. These are not established as equivalent.

alignment.rit_meaning: PDF version extracted from the file header.
alignment.rationale: CIC documents valid-header presence, whereas RIT stores a numeric extracted PDF version. Header strings must not be treated as a version transform without verification.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "obj" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: RIT counts obj string occurrences; CIC documents indirect objects and also has malformed category values. Parser/count equivalence is not established.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "endobj" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Related name, but the CIC official page does not separately define Endobj and raw values include non-numeric text.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "stream" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: RIT counts stream string occurrences; CIC documents streams as binary-data sequences. Equal parser/count semantics are not established.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "endstream" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Related name, but CIC Endstream is not separately defined in the official feature descriptions and raw values are malformed in places.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "trailer" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Both dictionaries describe a count of PDF trailers and use numeric local representations.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "xref" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: RIT counts xref occurrences while CIC documents Xref tables; count semantics are related but not proven equal.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "startxref" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Related startxref keyword count, but CIC includes malformed raw strings and exact parser behavior is not documented.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/Page" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Both appear page-related, but CIC PageNo is not separately defined and is not proven to count the /Page keyword.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/Encrypt" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Related names, but CIC's Encrypt column is distinct from isEncrypted and is not separately defined on the official page.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/ObJStm" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Both dictionaries describe stream objects (ObjStm) as a numeric count.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/JS" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Both refer to JS-related keywords/objects, but CIC's category values contain unverified malformed encodings such as 1(1).

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/JavaScript" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Both refer to JavaScript-related keywords/objects, but CIC category encodings include malformed values and exact parser semantics are not established.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/AA" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Related keyword-count concept, but CIC categorical malformed values prevent a defensible raw representation equivalence.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/OpenAction" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Related keyword-count concept, but CIC categorical malformed values prevent a defensible raw representation equivalence.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/Acroform" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Related tag-count concept, but CIC categorical malformed values and RIT's documented zero variance require review before sharing it.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/JBIG2Decode" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: RIT counts occurrences while CIC documentation describes presence; a count is not automatically equivalent to an indicator.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/RichMedia" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Related keyword-count concept, but CIC categorical malformed values prevent a defensible raw representation equivalence.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/Launch" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Related keyword-count concept, but CIC categorical malformed values prevent a defensible raw representation equivalence.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/EmbeddedFile" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Related name, but CIC's EmbeddedFile column is not separately defined and contains malformed category values.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/XFA" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: Related XFA concept, but CIC's exact count/indicator semantics and malformed categorical representation require review.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/Colors > 2^24" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: The RIT feature counts /Colors > 2^24 occurrences, whereas CIC documents different colors used. Same name is not a defensible semantic equivalence.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/URI" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: No CIC URI column is present in the actual local schema.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/BaseEncoding" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: No CIC BaseEncoding column is present in the actual local schema.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/Encoding" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: No CIC Encoding column is present in the actual local schema.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/ProcSet" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: No CIC ProcSet column is present in the actual local schema.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/Registry" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: No CIC Registry column is present in the actual local schema.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/Resources" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: No CIC Resources column is present in the actual local schema.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/www" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: No CIC www column is present in the actual local schema.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/server" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: No CIC server column is present in the actual local schema.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/Root" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: No CIC Root column is present in the actual local schema.

alignment.rit_meaning: Number of occurrences of the string "/BitsPerComponent" in the PDF file.
alignment.rationale: No CIC BitsPerComponent column is present in the actual local schema.

limitations: RIT local CSV does not include original per-PDF SHA-256 values, so cross-dataset file identity or overlap cannot be proven.
CIC is a Kaggle third-party mirror and differs from official row/malicious counts; it is not claimed byte-identical to the CIC original.
No model, cross-dataset evaluation, target-based feature selection, learned transform, imputation, normalization, or ambiguous-category encoding is included.
A strict mapping establishes only documented feature comparability, not distributional equivalence or generalization.
